Department Resource Delete Department
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/departments/:departmentId

Deletes a department for an organization based on the specified ID.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
departmentId
int32
REQUIRED

Department ID

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
